name: Connecticut

windshield.strip: transparent material on the topmost portion, bottom edge at least 29 inches above the undepressed driver's seat (measured 5 in. in front of backrest), not red or amber

frontSide.note: not mirror-like; total light transmission not less than 35% plus or minus 3%; luminous reflectance 27% plus or minus 3%

backSide.note: right and left side windows behind the driver: 35% plus or minus 3%; reflectance 21% plus or minus 3%; not mirror-like

rear.note: rearmost window: 35% rule, or any darkness if outside mirrors on both sides show 200 feet to the rear (§ 14-99g(c)(10))

windshield.strip: same 29-inch topmost rule, not red or amber

frontSide.note: 35% plus or minus 3%, reflectance 27% plus or minus 3%

backSide.note: windows behind the driver on trucks, buses, trailers, mobile homes and multipurpose passenger vehicles (49 CFR 571.3) exempt if outside mirrors on both sides show 200 feet to the rear

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ("in conjunction with glazing material"; light transmission includes the glazing)

tolerance.cite: Conn. Gen. Stat. § 14-99g(c)(1), (5) ("plus or minus three per cent")

tint.dualMirrors: Outside mirrors on left and right sides (200-foot view) required to use darker rear window, and for darker windows behind the driver on trucks/MPVs
tint.certificateOrSticker: Post-factory tinted windows (vehicles made and sold on/after Jan 1, 1994) need a DMV-approved sticker, max one square inch, in the lower left corner of each tinted window (§ 14-99g(e))

medicalExemption.text: Person required for medical reasons to be shielded from direct sun (or operating that person's vehicle or one in which they are a usual passenger) is exempt; written application to the DMV Commissioner supported by documentation from a physician or optometrist licensed in Connecticut

penalty.text: Infraction for each offense; must remove the material and present the vehicle to the issuing police department within 60 days; repeat after failure to report can lead to impoundment

tint.lastAmended: P.A. 07-217 (last public act listed in the section history; 35% limits set by P.A. 93-135)
quotes: § 14-99g(c)(1): "...total light transmission of not less than thirty-five per cent plus or minus three per cent and a luminous reflectance of twenty-seven per cent plus or minus three per cent"

(c)(5): "The right and left side windows behind the driver and the rearmost window which shall not be mirror-like...not less than thirty-five per cent plus or minus three per cent and a luminous reflectance of twenty-one per cent..."

(c)(6): "The windows behind the driver on any truck, motor bus, trailer, mobile manufactured home, or multipurpose passenger vehicle...provided said vehicle is equipped with outside mirrors on the left and right-hand sides"
(c)(11): "(A) The bottom edge of the material is at least twenty-nine inches above the undepressed driver's seat... (B) the material is not red or amber in color"
(f): "Any person who violates any provision of subsections (b) to (e), inclusive, of this section shall be deemed to have committed an infraction for each offense."

helmet.conditions: Operators and passengers under 18 on a motorcycle or motor-driven cycle must wear FMVSS 218 headgear; infraction, fine not less than $90

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Drivers under 18 may not use any hand-held phone, even with a hands-free accessory, or mobile electronic device (§ 14-296aa(d))
handheldPhone.fineText: $200 first violation, $375 second, $625 third or subsequent

radarDetector.note: No Connecticut ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

underglow.rule: No light visible from the front other than white, yellow or amber; none visible from the rear other than red, yellow, amber or white; no red light visible from directly in front; flashing lights prohibited except listed uses; infraction

openQuestions: Infraction fine amount for § 14-99g not stated in statute (set by court infraction schedule) - not found
